subject: Post-call: Luminexa security prerequisites + SSO/SCIM evidence request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Romero <elena.romero@luminexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Luminexa security prerequisites + SSO/SCIM evidence request

Hi Elena —

Great to speak with you and the team this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Compliance posture
   - You mentioned Luminexa has a SOC 2 Type I report (in-house) and are targeting a Type II audit in Q3. Please confirm target quarter and any specific scope restrictions (e.g., data residency, subservice orgs).
   - GDPR applicability: noted; you’re the data controller for EU customers and require vendor processing agreements.
   - HIPAA: you indicated certain product lines require a BAA.

2) IAM / SSO needs (priority for pilot)
   - SAML 2.0 SP support required. Please send your IdP metadata (saml-metadata.xml) and the name of the IdP (Okta, AAD, etc.).
   - SCIM 2.0 provisioning: we’ll need the attribute mapping/schema you expect (email, externalId, groups, admin flag).
   - RBAC expectations: outline of admin vs. regular user roles, and any delegated admin workflows.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
   - Please attach the questionnaire you prefer us to complete. We can return a completed copy and attach supporting evidence (policy excerpts, screenshots).

4) Timeline & next steps
   - If you can share the IdP metadata + vendor questionnaire by end of week we’ll prioritize the SCIM mapping and provide a short technical walkthrough next week.
   - I’ll include Marissa (security enablement) on this thread for evidence collection and to coordinate any additional artifacts (SOC 2 report excerpts, admin control screenshots).

Attachments: none from our side yet — we can provide sample SAML SP metadata and our SCIM mapping once we receive your questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Romero <elena.romero@luminexa.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@luminexa.com, itops+security@luminexa.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Luminexa security prerequisites + SSO/SCIM evidence request

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary and follow-up. A few notes from our side:

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I report for the current calendar year. We are scheduled to enter a Type II audit cycle beginning 2027-10-01 with an anticipated report in Q1 2028. We can provide the Type I report and our SOC 2 scope document.

- GDPR & HIPAA: GDPR applies for our EU customers; we will need a Data Processing Addendum. HIPAA: certain customers require a BAA — we’ll confirm whether this pilot workload needs HIPAA coverage.

- IAM specifics: Okta is our primary IdP. I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire we use internally (luminexa_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx) and our current SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml). For SCIM, our team will want Redwood’s SCIM mapping and any provisioning examples so we can validate attribute sync.

Action items on our side: procurement will ingest Redwood’s answers once you return the completed questionnaire. ITOps will review SAML metadata and coordinate test IdP connectors.

Do you have a template SCIM mapping or example CSV we can use as a starting point? Would also appreciate any short admin controls doc describing how Redwood handles RBAC and delegated admins (screenshots + admin audit log examples).

Attaching: luminexa_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx, saml-metadata.xml

Best,
Elena Romero
Head of Information Security | Luminexa
elena.romero@luminexa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Romero <elena.romero@luminexa.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, procurement@luminexa.com, itops+security@luminexa.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Luminexa security prerequisites + SSO/SCIM evidence request

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick turn. Sharing the requested artifacts from Redwood to keep things moving:

- redwood_sso_instructions.pdf (short SP setup guide for Okta/Azure AD) — includes sample assertion attributes and ACS/EntityID values.
- scim-provisioning-schema.csv — a compact SCIM attribute mapping we typically share with customers (email, externalId, displayName, groups, isAdmin boolean).
- A partially completed copy of your questionnaire is attached in the Drive link; we’ll return the XLSX fully completed by EOD Monday.

Quick notes on RBAC and admin controls:
- Roles: Owner (org-wide admin), Admin (team-level admin), User. Owners can manage billing and integrations; Admin can manage users and teams; User has runtime access only.
- Audit logs: Admin actions (role changes, SCIM provisioning events) are stored for 12 months in the Console and can be exported in CSV.
- Delegated admin: We support org-level and team-level delegations; mapping is configurable during provisioning.

Next steps:
1) We’ll complete the questionnaire and attach supporting evidence (SOC 2 Type II in-progress note + policy excerpts) by Monday EOD.
2) If you can provision a test Okta connector for the pilot or allow us to use your sandbox metadata, we’ll run SCIM sync tests during the technical walkthrough.
3) Proposed times for the walkthrough: use the Calendly link in my signature or propose slots.

Attachments in this message: redwood_sso_instructions.pdf, scim-provisioning-schema.csv

Marissa / Aditya —

Received, and thanks for the artifacts. I reviewed the SSO guide and the SCIM schema — both look like the format our team expects. Procurement has also confirmed they will accept the completed questionnaire and supporting evidence for initial commercial review.

A couple of final items from our side:
- We will need a short BAA addendum only if the pilot requires PHI; procurement will advise once we decide pilot scope (expected by Friday).
- I have attached a signed NDA for Redwood (signed_nda.pdf) so our teams can exchange any sensitive artifacts if needed.

Next: I’ll provision a test Okta application using the saml-metadata.xml you provided and loop in the itops team to schedule the SCIM sync test. Please expect a calendar invite for Monday morning.

Thanks — talk soon.

Elena
